name: identify_tf_binding_sites
description: Identify transcription factor binding sites in a DNA sequence by querying JASPAR motif database
usage: from app.tools.biomni.genetics import identify_tf_binding_sites; result = identify_tf_binding_sites('ATGGCTAGCTAGCGATCGATCGATCGATCG', tf_names=['TP53', 'CTCF', 'SP1'], threshold=0.8)

parameters.sequence: str — DNA sequence to scan for TF binding sites
parameters.tf_names: list — TF names to scan e.g. ['TP53', 'CTCF', 'SP1'] (default: common TFs)

returns: dict with keys: sequence_length, tfs_queried, jaspar_matrices (list of {tf, jaspar_matrix, note})
